_what: Bing Webmaster Tools Keyword Research, read from the signed-in console on 2026-08-26, for the dentistry seeds that WPP-llm/docs/query-coverage/blue-ocean.md marked NEEDS_BING. Companion to data/signals/bing_webmaster_baseline.json, which is the model this file copies.
unit: Bing Webmaster Tools impressions for the seed over the stated window. NOT Google impressions, and NOT Semrush modelled market volume. Do not compare these figures against T1 GSC impressions or T2b modelled volume without saying which is which.
reading_rule: 'insufficient_data' is Bing's own response ('Bing doesn't have enough data to show trend here'). It is a measured absence at Bing's reporting floor. It is enough to refuse a build. It is not proof that nobody searches the query, and it says nothing about Google.

seeds.serp_shape: Editorial and authority prose - medicare.gov, Humana, U.S. News, SeniorLiving, MedicareFAQ. No price data and no downloadable artifact is required to compete.
seeds.action: REPAIR, not create. Filed as a create in data/community/approval_queue.json and correctly rejected by the release queue as SKIP_DUPLICATE:equivalent_title_exists, then refiled as REPAIR_INTENDED_WINNER_PAGE with the sourced content in recommended_action. The existing page cites SRC-ADA-MOUTHHEALTHY - the American Dental Association's consumer site - as its only source for a Medicare coverage question, which that source cannot support.
seeds.related_keywords_rows: 2 rows returned, both junk: 'uihost.exe mcafee webadvisor user level process' (404) and 'mooresville radar' (210). Bing's related-keyword data is noise on this property and was not used.

seeds.query: how long do dental implants last
seeds.serp_shape: 10 of 10 results are editorial prose - healthline.com, periodontal and dental practice sites, clearchoice.com, dentalroundup.com. No prices, no forms, no calculators.
seeds.action: BUILT. /dentistry/guides/how-long-do-dental-implants-last/, admitted 2026-08-26. The only net-new URL taken from this measurement round.

seeds.bing_message: Bing doesn't have enough data to show trend here.
seeds.serp_shape: 10 of 10 results carry per-city verified price data - realdentalcosts.com/en/iowa/des-moines/, truedentalcosts.com/ia/des-moines (publishing a full-mouth range of $21,750-$78,300), dentistsranked.com, thedentalhealers.com, dentillo.com.
seeds.action: REFUSED. This is the measurement that settles the dentistry city-page question. blue-ocean.md deliberately excluded the city axis on judgement; it is now excluded on evidence. There is no measurable Bing demand at the city grain, and the incumbents hold a per-city price database that this repository does not have. Opening a city permutation axis in a library already 2,001 pages over its maintainable ceiling would add cost and no reach.

seeds.query: can i use hsa for dental implants
seeds.bing_message: Bing doesn't have enough data to show trend here.
seeds.action: REFUSED. Ranked 6th on the blue-ocean.md 'genuinely promising' list on the reasoning that HSA and FSA appear in zero of the 217 dentistry pages. The gap is real; the demand is below Bing's floor. A gap is not an opportunity.

seeds.bing_message: Bing doesn't have enough data to show trend here.
seeds.serp_shape: medicaid.gov, state Medicaid programmes, GoodRx, realdentalcosts.com state-by-state Medicaid table.
seeds.action: REFUSED. Note the shape though: this is the one refused seed where the 50-state axis this repository already owns would be legitimate, because Medicaid dental benefits genuinely differ by state. Worth re-measuring after the existing state pages carry per-state substance.

seeds.query: how long does a dental implant take to heal
seeds.bing_message: Bing doesn't have enough data to show trend here.
seeds.action: REFUSED. Tested specifically as a candidate for a second net-new page alongside the lifespan page. It does not clear the floor, so only one page was built where the weekly cadence cap allowed two.

conclusions: Two dentistry queries clear Bing's reporting floor: `does medicare cover dental implants` at 304 and `how long do dental implants last` at 204. Both are answerable from a single authoritative federal source and neither needs a price on the page, so neither collides with the separate pricing work in this vertical.
One of the two already had a page. That turned the second half of this work from a build into a repair, which is what docs/strategy/publishing-cadence.md asks for past ~50 published pages.
The city axis is measured as empty at the seed grain and saturated at the SERP grain. Do not open it.

Four of six seeds tested returned no data. The honest read of that is not that dentistry has no demand - the property has 5 measured Bing impressions in total - but that Bing's keyword tool only resolves head terms at this property's visibility, and that a keyword-by-keyword build programme cannot be run off it.
